notes.title: Play STACK at Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Exciting news! STACK is participating in Steam Next Fest!

The free Demo is available until June 26. 

Get ready to dive into the world of Stack and experience its thrilling gameplay firsthand! Share your feedback, connect with fellow VR gamers, and enjoy all that STACK has to offer.

Two modes are now available - Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch. You can play in public and private lobbies up to 5v5 players. 

Don't miss out on this opportunity and wishlist the game to get notified about the full release!

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/stackvr]discord community[/url] to chat and find teammates.
